title: Communications Design Laboratory
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in ENEE322 or ENEE323; and minimum grade of C- in ENEE324 or STAT400; and completion of all lower-division technical courses in the EE curriculum.
Recommended: ENEE420 and ENEE425.
Restriction: Must be in Engineering: Electrical or Engineering: Computer program; and permission of Electrical and Computing Engineering Department.
Credit only granted for: ENEE427 or ENEE428.
Formerly: ENEE428.
